purpose: Define Merit Analyze as an Expose function that projects MeritCore evidence, points, Tier qualification, recommendations and temporal distribution for inspection without becoming a scoring authority.

topics.name: Merit Analyze
topics.purpose: Define Merit Analyze as an Expose function that projects MeritCore evidence, points, Tier qualification, recommendations and temporal distribution for inspection without becoming a scoring authority.

semantics.analysis_rule: Analysis reads accepted MeritCore semantics and may compute non-authoritative explanatory projections.
semantics.qc_rule: QC may be used as a selected local/external analysis backend where configured, but QC output does not directly mutate MeritCore.
semantics.target_rule: Analysis target is an exact identity/Project/evidence ref.
semantics.mutation_rule: Any accepted MeritCore change uses separate explicit MeritCore operation/review workflow.
semantics.authority_rule: Expose function has no AccessCore bypass.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed derived values retain source/rule refs.

invariants.rule: MeritCore-derived points, Tier, recommendations and trust remain bound to one identity and explicit Project/evidence history; they cannot be manufactured by presentation, identity merging or time-splitting.

hard_gates.condition: QC output automatically becomes MeritCore truth

references.purpose: Analysis can expose point calculation trace.
